Index of physics articles
Physics
(Greek:
physis
–φύσις meaning "nature") is the
natural science
which examines basic concepts such as
mass
,
charge
,
matter
[
1
]
and its
motion
and all that derives from these, such as
energy
,
force
and
spacetime
.
[
2
]
More broadly, it is the general analysis of
nature
, conducted in order to understand how the
world
and
universe
behave.
[
3
]
